## Hello, I'm Ifeanyi (E-FINE-YI).

I'm a Data Scientist with a curiosity for statistics, mathematics, machine learning, and the questions that emerge when theory meets real-world data.

I enjoy understanding not just how statistical methods work, but why they work, the assumptions they depend on, and what happens when those assumptions are challenged.

## Why I Write

*I Write What I Likelihood* is inspired by Steve Biko's *I Write What I Like*.

The idea is simple: to have a space where I can explore whatever interests me intellectually.

Sometimes that means deriving a likelihood function from first principles. Other times, it means experimenting with statistical models, reproducing an interesting result, or investigating something I don't fully understand.

This journal is a record of that curiosity.

## What You'll Find Here

- Mathematical explorations and derivations.
- Statistical modelling and inference.
- Computational experiments and simulations.
- Machine learning investigations.
- Questions, discoveries, and occasional failed experiments.

I don't expect every investigation to produce something new.

Sometimes understanding something deeply is the discovery itself.

## Elsewhere

You can find some of my implementations and experiments on [GitHub](https://github.com/Ifeanyi-omeck).

---

*Curiosity first. Equations along the way.*
